title: Maximum Candies You Can Get from Boxes

monster.name: Confection Fiend
monster.title: Opener of Nested Treasure Lockboxes
monster.defeatQuote: Total candies harvested through discovered keys and openable chests!

description: You have `n` boxes labeled from 0 to `n - 1`. You are given `status` (1 = open, 0 = locked), `candies`, `keys`, `containedBoxes`, and `initialBoxes`. You can open an unlocked box or unlock a locked box if you have its key. Return the maximum candies you can collect.
starterCode:
def maxCandies(status: list[int], candies: list[int], keys: list[list[int]], containedBoxes: list[list[int]], initialBoxes: list[int]) -> int:
    pass
solutionCode:
def maxCandies(status: list[int], candies: list[int], keys: list[list[int]], containedBoxes: list[list[int]], initialBoxes: list[int]) -> int:
    from collections import deque
    has_box = set(initialBoxes)
    has_key = set()
    q = deque([b for b in initialBoxes if status[b] == 1])
    opened = set()
    total = 0
    while q:
        b = q.popleft()
        if b in opened: continue
        opened.add(b)
        total += candies[b]
        for k in keys[b]:
            has_key.add(k)
            if k in has_box and k not in opened:
                q.append(k)
        for cb in containedBoxes[b]:
            has_box.add(cb)
            if (status[cb] == 1 or cb in has_key) and cb not in opened:
                q.append(cb)
    return total
hints: Queue a box as soon as you have BOTH the box and its key (or it was initially open).
